concepts.description: A modular unit of the AUV system that encapsulates components and interfaces.
A physical or logical platform within the AUV system that interacts with sensors and actuators.
A defined boundary through which components of the AUV system communicate and exchange data or events.
A control component within the AUV system responsible for managing specific operational logic or behaviour.
A basic, indivisible data type used to represent fundamental values within the AUV system.
A structured data type composed of multiple named fields, each with their own type, used to represent complex values within the AUV system.
A named element within a CompositeType that holds a value of a specified type.
A named data field within an Interface that holds a specific type of data for use by components in the AUV system.
A named signal or action defined within an Interface that can be triggered by components in the AUV system, optionally with parameters and a return value.
A named computational operation defined within the AUV system that takes inputs and returns a result.

instances.description: The top-level module representing the entire AUV system.
The robotic platform contained within AUV_Module, using the Sensors and Actuators interfaces.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Platform to interact with sensor data.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Platform to interact with actuator commands.
A controller contained within AUV_Module that uses the Inputs interface for receiving operational commands.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Operator to receive input commands.
The Last Response Engine controller contained within AUV_Module, using the Inputs and Outputs interfaces.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by LRE_Ctrl and AUV_Autopilot to send output commands.
A controller contained within AUV_Module responsible for autopilot functionality, using the Outputs interface.
A primitive type representing natural numbers, defined within AUV_Module.
A primitive type representing integer numbers, defined within AUV_Module.
A primitive type representing string values, defined within AUV_Module.
A primitive type representing boolean values, defined within AUV_Module.
A primitive type representing real numbers, defined within AUV_Module.
A composite type representing a Spherical Vector, containing radial, polar, and azimuth fields of type real.
A field of type real within the SVec composite type representing the radial component of a spherical vector.
A field of type real within the SVec composite type representing the polar component of a spherical vector.
A field of type real within the SVec composite type representing the azimuth component of a spherical vector.
A composite type representing an obstacle, containing fields ns_rel_dist, ew_rel_dist, depth, id (all of type real), and obs_hdng of type SVec.
A field of type real within the Obstacle composite type representing the north-south relative distance.
A field of type real within the Obstacle composite type representing the east-west relative distance.
A field of type real within the Obstacle composite type representing the depth of the obstacle.
A field of type real within the Obstacle composite type representing the identifier of the obstacle.
A field of type SVec within the Obstacle composite type representing the heading of the obstacle.
A value of type SVec within the Sensors interface representing the heading measurement.
A value of type Obstacle within the Sensors interface representing observed obstacle data.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, signalling the end of a task.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting obstacle collision mode.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting manual operation mode.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting heading control mode.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters but with a return value of type real, requesting the current velocity.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters but with a return value of type real, requesting the current heading.
An event in the Outputs interface that takes one parameter of type real and has no return value, advising velocity.
An event in the Outputs interface that takes one parameter of type real and has no return value, advising heading.
A composite type representing close distance assessment data, containing horiz_cda and vert_cda of type real, and id of type nat.
A field of type real within the Close composite type representing the horizontal close distance assessment.
A field of type real within the Close composite type representing the vertical close distance assessment.
A function defined in AUV_Module that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the distance from the AUV to the obstacle as a real number.
A function defined in AUV_Module that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the horizontal distance from the AUV to the obstacle as a real number.
A function defined in AUV_Module that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the vertical distance from the AUV to the obstacle as a real number.
